title: Private Mortgage Insurance Cancellation Simplification Act of 1998

latest_action.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR E1607)

summaries.text: Private Mortgage Insurance Cancellation Simplification Act of 1998 - Amends the Homeowners Protection Act of 1998 to apply the borrower termination and automatic cancellation provisions to high-risk loans. Provides that, other than with respect to inconsistencies, such Act does not affect compliance with State laws regarding private residential mortgage insurance.
